ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy commit e5b7d0a3c6f9b2e applied config changeset cs-20240314-0441 at 2024-03-14T08:02:11Z, which inadvertently removed the min_healthy_host_count key from the ap-northeast-2 dns-resolver fleet configuration. The config manager did not validate the semantic meaning of removed keys and silently fell back to a system default of 2 (from the intended value of 100). With the minimum healthy threshold effectively disabled, the autoscaler (whose cooldown period had been shortened in commit d4a6c9f2b5e8a1d) aggressively drained the fleet from 142 hosts down to 8 within ~13 minutes, causing >90% of in-VPC DNS queries from EC2 instances including all OTel demo services to fail.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately halt the autoscaler for the dns-resolver fleet in ap-northeast-2 to stop further host removal. 2. Provision replacement hosts to restore fleet capacity to >=100 healthy hosts. 3. Push corrected config changeset restoring min_healthy_host_count=100 to fleet-config.json. 4. Once DNS resolution rates return to normal and fleet shows >=100 healthy hosts with correct threshold, close the incident. Long-term: add semantic config validation that rejects changesets removing required safety keys without explicit acknowledgment, and add per-hour throttling on host removal.
